securityPage.title: I find the boundary, reproduce the failure, and fix it.
securityPage.intro: I started at eight by reverse-engineering games to understand how software worked. More than {years} years into my professional engineering career, I bring that same curiosity to defensive application security across identity, authorization, untrusted uploads, and cloud boundaries.
securityPage.proof: The work below is public, merged, and linked to a reproduction or regression test.

security.title: Three defensive fixes, with the proof attached.
security.sub: Each case starts with an observed security risk and ends with a scoped fix plus a regression check.

assetBoundary.title: Prevented untrusted assets from executing on the application origin
assetBoundary.body: Reproduced a stored-XSS risk where a compromised R2 object could be served as HTML on this portfolio's origin. Replaced the proxy rewrite with a typed streaming route and restrictive response headers.

caseStudy.label: Read the case study
caseStudy.cause: The same-origin PDF rewrite forwarded the asset host's Content-Type. Control of that upstream response could make the browser interpret HTML inside the portfolio origin.
caseStudy.fix: I replaced the rewrite with a route that streams the body under a fixed PDF content type, nosniff, a fixed disposition, and explicit cache headers. Upstream response headers are discarded.
caseStudy.validation: A controlled local upstream reproduced script execution before the change. After it, the route returned the same bytes as application/pdf with nosniff. Production still serves a valid PDF through that contract.
caseStudy.limits: The route does not inspect PDF structure or prove that production storage was compromised. The malicious-upstream regression remained a manual check because this repository had no automated test suite.

identity.title: Made OTPs single-use under concurrency
identity.body: Moved OTP consumption into one atomic PostgreSQL update and added concurrency coverage across 25 code pairs. Every pair produced one success and one rejection.

authorization.title: Bound image upload grants to the caller
authorization.body: Added short-lived upload grants with ownership, exact-byte signatures, hourly caps, and cleanup. Only the user who requested a grant can claim it when creating or editing a profile.
